gap_text: Skfolio acceptance covers chronological splitting in a project-local raw-price label study. It excludes dividend-inclusive returns, financing, realistic fills, capacity and portfolio cash reconciliation.

preregistration.written_at_note: Upper bound: the commit time of the first preregistration commit (4484138). Written between 06:18:35Z and that commit; corrected in the same unpushed commit before any check ran.
preregistration.expectation: Same Nautilus run as gap 0; the ADJ arm supplies dividend-inclusive bars, the MakerTakerFeeModel supplies fees, cash is reconciled; a daily-volume participation admission check (order qty <= 1% of session volume) is reported.
criteria: As gap 0 criteria for fills, fees and cash.
Outcome ceiling: advanced; realistic fills (queue, spread, impact), financing and in-engine dividend crediting remain.

fix_rounds.label: fix round 1 (gaps 0 and 10), written after round-1 Nautilus output was seen
fix_rounds.trigger: Round 1: RAW arms reconciled exactly; both ADJ arms failed the cash-sequence audit ('cash sequence mismatch', 'final cash 89651.82 != independent 89651.9250'; reserved '100814.92 != 100814.9167') and the realized-PnL identity. ADJ prices have 4 decimals, so qty*price has sub-cent notional; the independent arithmetic did not round it.
fix_rounds.diagnosis: Testing five rounding rules against round-1 development-ADJ reports: per-fill notional rounded to cents with ROUND_HALF_EVEN matched all 276 cash transitions (HALF_UP 163, DOWN/FLOOR 5, CEILING 6). Per-position realized PnL matched round_half_even(qty*(exit-entry)) - fees in 136/138 positions; the 2 others differ by 0.01 at exact half-cent ties (consistent with binary floating-point rounding).
fix_rounds.change: Audit v2 rounds each fill notional to cents with ROUND_HALF_EVEN before the cash update (declared engine currency-precision convention, fitted on development-ADJ round 1; the reserved-ADJ arm's 20 fills act as a check that was not used for fitting). Realized PnL is checked per position with tolerance 0.01 USD; the sum residual against the cash delta is reported, not asserted. Strategy, schedule, prices and engine configuration are unchanged; round-1 outputs are retained.
criteria: All four arms: every cash transition equals independent arithmetic under the declared rule.
Per-position realized PnL within 0.01 USD of independent value; report count of exact matches and total residual.

results.summary: The skfolio study's frozen selections ran through Nautilus 2.0.0rc5 with dividend-inclusive back-adjusted bars (ADJ arm) and MakerTakerFeeModel 10 bp per side; portfolio cash reconciled exactly in all four arms under audit v2 (development ADJ: 276 fills, fees 27407.36 USD, ending cash 89651.82). Participation at most 0.0000844 of session volume (1% admission rule met). Financing is zero by construction (cash account, no margin or short).

detection_method: As receipt 0: the exact cash audit caught the sub-cent rounding in round 1.
remaining: Realistic fills (spread, queue, impact, partial fills), capacity beyond a volume-participation ratio, and financing models are not exercised. Dividend-inclusive bars are back-adjusted, so their prices were not tradable historically. In-engine dividend cash crediting is peer-owned (dividend SimulationModule, sota-workflow-resolution).
